race.comment: CAPITAL CHORD (4) is the horse to beat if she can reproduce her Ipswich run two starts ago, when fourth in a Benchmark 65 and beaten only a length and a half. Her Eagle Farm ninth last week came in mid-week 3yo+ Class 1 company after an awkward start and early steadying, and the return to 1200m is supported by a win from two tries at the distance. Can threaten. LA NARRADORA (13) brings winning form from Grafton, where she overcame early interference and a held-up moment to beat Rubology on soft ground. She is new to this state, but she can go on with it. NEXT STOP JUPITER (9) has the cleanest local profile, winning both starts at this track and missing narrowly in 3yo+ Class 3 grade at Bowen. In the mix. LONHY'S FABRE (5) is honest, lightly raced and was close up first-up at Mackay, so he is a chance if he builds from that return.
